thread:
maya: Heads up — we have a new 1099 contractor starting Mon (Alex). Need to confirm onboarding checklist: do we require I-9 for 1099s? Background check status, laptop/badge logistics, and day-1 orientation slot please.
raj: Short answer — I-9 is generally for employees. For 1099 we need a W-9 + signed contractor agreement. If role touches customer data/CUI we might want extra verification. Marina, is this CUI? Background check status?
marina-recruiter: Not CUI. Alex completed Checkr consent last week; report uploaded to HR drive but final review pending. I also collected a filled W-9 and uploaded to /HR/1099s/Alex. (link: drive.google.com/hidden) 
alex-contractor: Confirmed — I uploaded the W-9 and consent. I'll be BYOD for my laptop. I do need VPN + SSO access and a dev Slack invite for day 1. 
jordan-it: BYOD is fine if Alex signs the AUP and we install our MDM or connect through secure VPN only. I'll need Alex's full name, phone, and personal email to provision temporary badge and SSO invite. We can do temporary badge pickup Friday.
maya: @raj can you confirm legal/comp exceptions? Also we need to flag this as 1099 in the HRIS and set pay code. Marina, please share contract clause regarding background checks.
raj: Confirming: I-9 not required for independent contractors. Use W-9 + contractor agreement + any client-specific compliance clauses. If contract requires onsite access to sensitive systems, we might request additional ID verification — that'd be an exception. Otherwise proceed with standard 1099 flow.
marina-recruiter: Contract clause posted to the candidate folder (see drive link above). Background check shows education verification pending — no serious flags but pending. I'll chase Checkr follow-up now.
alex-contractor: I finished the AUP form and remote access request (submitted). Small ask: can I get read-only access to the monorepo to review infra docs before Monday?
jordan-it: I'll create a temporary read-only CI role and add Alex to the contractors Slack group. Once W-9 is processed and AUP signed, I'll send the SSO invite. Expect invites by EOD Friday if HR clears paperwork.
hr-bot: Reminder: Background check status for alex-contractor — education verification pending. Marina to follow up (automated reminder sent).
marina-recruiter: Following up now with candidate and Checkr. ETA end of day for finalization; will update this thread.
maya: Plan summary: 1) Confirm W-9 + AUP (done), 2) Marina completes background check review (ETA EOD), 3) Jordan to provision temp badge + SSO + repo read-only (target Fri), 4) Add Alex to Day-1 orientation schedule (welcome, security quickstart, intro to buddy). If BG clears, convert to full contractor access Monday.
alex-contractor: Awesome — thank you all. One last: expense policy for travel — who to submit receipts to? I have to come onsite for orientation.
maya: Ping finance-ops or me. I'll DM the travel reimbursement link and code after this thread. :thumbsup: 
marina-recruiter: Updated thread: Checkr follow-up complete, education verified. All green. I'll mark folder as cleared.
jordan-it: Provisioning queued — badge and SSO invites scheduled for Fri 3pm. Slack invite and repo role will follow. 
maya: Perfect. Welcome aboard, Alex — see you Monday! :wave:
